details:
Q1: What should this issue change?
Choices:
A. One specific workflow phase (clarify, plan, implement, review/autofix, orchestrate, validate, heal, triage). Name the phase and the problem you see. (RECOMMENDED)
B. One specific script, prompt or doc file. Give its path and say what is wrong with it.
C. A specific failure you saw in a run. Give the run, PR or issue link and the error.
D. Nothing specific. Close the issue as not actionable. (RECOMMENDED)
Q2: How will we know it is "better"?
Choices:
A. A named bug no longer happens. Describe the current and the expected behaviour. (RECOMMENDED)
B. A measurable change, such as fewer API calls, less runtime or fewer failed runs. State the metric and the target.
C. A new capability. Describe what it must do.
